doc: One rock to make: what the game asks for ("a large mossy granite boulder in winter"), plus the seed that makes it differ from its neighbours and the level of detail the runtime picked.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: How big: small (knee high, about 0.6 m across), medium (about 1.2 m), large (about 2.2 m), or huge (a boulder, about 4 m).

fields.name: moss
fields.doc: Moss and lichen on its upper faces.

fields.name: season
fields.doc: The time of year (snow in winter).

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Stable randomness: the shape and the way it breaks.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Level of detail, chosen by the runtime from distance and quality.
